evidence: Modifies kernel API boundary headers (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp) to plumb explicit Logger instances and remove global logger dependencies.
rationale: Decouples kernel objects from the global logger singleton so libbitcoinkernel consumers and multi-instance tests can control logging output independently. While worthwhile for kernel modularity, reviewers note it adds interface complexity and substantial rebase churn without immediate external consumer demand.
